title: Verified JEE PYQ metadata record
description: Metadata + provenance for one officially published JEE question. Never stores question text or images. Every exam-history fact must be traceable to the official paper.

question_id.description: Stable SnapNote record ID. Never changes after issuance.

session.description: Main session label exactly as published (e.g. 'April 2026'). Null when not applicable.

shift.description: Shift label exactly as published (e.g. 'Shift 1 (2 Apr 2026)'). Null when unverifiable.

concept_ids.description: Canonical taxonomy concept IDs, primary concept first. Every ID must exist in the taxonomy.

concept_mapping_note.description: One line explaining what the question tests (human-verified reading, not exam data).

nta_question_id.description: NTA's own Question Id from the official paper. Null for Advanced papers that lack one.

marks.description: Marks only when derivable from the official paper (section_marks / section_questions). NEVER inferred.

marks_basis.description: Exact arithmetic/provenance for marks, or null when marks is null.

difficulty.description: Only when independently verified against an official source. NEVER inferred. Null means unknown.

answer_key.description: Official answer reference (e.g. NTA option ID) only when read from the official answer key. Null otherwise.

content_fingerprint.description: Stable deduplication hash (sha256 of question_id + source_url). Detects accidental re-ingestion.

question_summary.description: Neutral one-line description of what the question asks (verified reading). No answers, no difficulty claims.

verification_method.description: How a human verified this record (e.g. 'visually read from official NTA paper PDF').
